metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2012 · The Avengers
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · Earth's mightiest heroes must come together and learn to fight as a team if they are going to stop the mischievous Loki and his alien army from enslaving humanity.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2011 · X-Men: First Class
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · In the 1960s, superpowered humans Charles Xavier and Erik Lensherr work together to find others like them, but Erik's vengeful pursuit of an ambitious mutant who ruined his life causes a schism to divide them.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 1999 · The Matrix
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · A computer hacker discovers that his life is nothing more than an elaborate simulation run by an evil AI.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2016 · Captain America: Civil War
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · Political involvement in the Avengers' affairs causes a rift between Captain America and Iron Man.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2012 · The Amazing Spider-Man
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · After Peter Parker is bitten by a genetically altered spider, he gains newfound, spider-like powers and ventures out to save the city from the machinations of a mysterious reptilian foe.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2009 · X-Men Origins: Wolverine
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · The early years of James Logan, featuring his rivalry with his brother Victor Creed, his service in the special forces team Weapon X, and his experimentation into the metal-lined mutant Wolverine.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2008 · The Incredible Hulk
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · Bruce Banner, a scientist on the run from the U.S. Government, must find a cure for the monster he turns into whenever he loses his temper.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2003 · The Matrix Reloaded
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · Freedom fighters Neo, Trinity and Morpheus continue to lead the revolt against the Machine Army, unleashing their arsenal of extraordinary skills and weaponry against the systematic forces of repression and exploitation.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2012 · Battlestar Galactica: Blood & Chrome
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · The adventures of young William Adama in the First Cylon War.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2003 · The Matrix Revolutions
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · The human city of Zion defends itself against the massive invasion of the machines as Neo fights to end the war at another front while also opposing the rogue Agent Smith.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2009 · District 9
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · In a future Earth in which aliens are isolated in a remote ghetto, a government agent finds himself banished there.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2009 · Star Trek
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · The brash James T. Kirk tries to live up to his father's legacy with Mr. Spock keeping him in check as a vengeful Romulan from the future creates black holes to destroy the Federation one planet at a time.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2006 · V for Vendetta
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · A young woman living in a dystopian society meets a shadowy freedom fighter who is plotting to overthrow their tyrannical government.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2015 · Mad Max: Fury Road
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners, a psychotic worshipper and a drifter named Max.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2011 · Rise of the Planet of the Apes
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · A substance designed to help the brain repair itself gives advanced intelligence to a chimpanzee who leads an ape uprising.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2018 · Avengers: Infinity War
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · The Avengers and their allies must be willing to sacrifice all in an attempt to defeat the powerful Thanos before his blitz of devastation and ruin puts an end to the universe.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2014 · Edge of Tomorrow
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · A man fighting in a war against aliens must relive the same day every time he dies until he can find a way to stop their power source with the help of an elite soldier.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2014 · X-Men: Days of Future Past
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · The X-Men send Wolverine to the past in a desperate effort to change history and prevent an event that results in doom for both humans and mutants.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2019 · Avengers: Endgame
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2003 · Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines
metas.description: More like Iron Man 2 · John Connor must face a female Terminator with power over all the machines. But a new Terminator unit, a T-850, is sent back through time to help guide him through the coming battle.
